title: Image content
description: An Image Resource owns its picture's URL, not its bytes (ADR 0106), so it uses the URL form of the locator: an https: or http: URL, or /images/<content-id> for a picture in the aggregate's shared image store, whose bytes Export carries in the Aggregate directory's images/ (ADR 0118).

anyOf.description: An external URL. The pattern refuses only what intake refuses: an http: or https: scheme in any case, after the leading C0 controls and spaces and the tabs and newlines a WHATWG URL parser discards. Intake also requires the whole string to parse as a WHATWG URL.
A stored image's content id: the SHA-256 of its bytes as unpadded base64url, 43 characters in canonical spelling (ADR 0106).

naturalSize.description: The picture's size in pixels, measured when the URL was set; absent when it did not load.
